subject: Re: Juno Health case study release — scheduling and legal sign-off
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@junohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Juno Health case study — draft + proposed press window

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for agreeing to do a customer spotlight with us. Attached is the first draft of the case study plus a small logo pack. We want to make sure the quote language and any legal items are cleared well ahead of the press window.

Key asks: 
- Can you review the attached draft and send back a short preferred quote (1–2 sentences) by EOD Tue Apr 6?
- Are there any legal reviewers at Juno we should loop in now? I cc’d Marissa (PR) and Monica (CS) so we can keep internal owners aligned.
- Proposed embargo window: publish on Tue Apr 20 at 12:00 PM PT. Does that work for Juno’s PR calendar? If you need a different date, please propose an alternate.

Quick timeline we have in mind: 
- Apr 3–6: quote and legal sign-off
- Apr 7–12: final asset packaging (logos, pullquotes, hero screenshot)
- Apr 13: final approval from both sides
- Apr 20: publish (embargo lift)

Attachments: Juno_CaseStudy_Draft_v1.docx (draft case study), Juno_Logo_Pack.zip (logo files)

If helpful, we can take a 20-min call early next week to walk through edits.

Thanks —

Grace O'Connor
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0139

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@junohealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: press@junohealth.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Juno Health case study — draft + proposed press window

Thanks Grace — appreciate the clear timeline and draft. Quick notes: 

- The draft looks great overall. I circled back with our comms lead and they prefer a slightly shorter quote. Please see suggested quote below (feel free to place it as the hero pullquote):

  "Redwood made inference predictable and cut our per-request latency in half — enabling real-time patient triage workflows."

- Apr 20 at 12:00 PM PT works for Juno from a scheduling perspective, but I need final sign-off from legal on the asset and the quote. Their team is looped at legal@junohealth.com.
- Attaching our primary logo set (png/svg). I also flagged a single sentence in the draft that references a specific internal metric; legal will ask to anonymize that or add a source.

I can get a first-pass response from legal by EOD Mon Apr 5. If we hit any delays we should push the final approval cutoff to Apr 14 to give buffer.

Happy to jump on a quick call Monday morning if that helps.

Best,
Alyssa Park
Head of Partnerships, Juno Health
alyssa@junohealth.com
(212) 555-0198

Attachments: Juno_Logo_Pack.zip

Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Looping legal + proposed edits for anonymization

Hi all —

Looping in Juno legal to confirm the note Alyssa mentioned about the internal metric. From our side, suggested options: remove the specific number, replace with a percentage, or add parenthetical source attribution (internal analysis, March 2027). We prefer to keep a simple headline metric but are fine with the anonymized phrasing if that's a blocker.

Marissa — once legal confirms, can you and Grace update the doc and push the final to the Drive link? Monica — can you prepare the short CS blurb (1–2 lines) for the callout box?

I’ll also prepare a short embargo checklist for Apr 20: press contact list, embargo note, push-to-live checklist, and a fallback plan if legal needs more time.

Ben Carter
Lead, Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0117

Quick update from legal — they reviewed the draft and are comfortable with the language if we make two small edits:

1) Replace the specific internal metric sentence with: "We observed a measurable uplift in inference throughput after migration to Redwood (internal Juno analysis)."
2) Add the following legal attribution line at the bottom of the case study: "Data based on Juno Health internal analysis, March 2027. Juno Health retains all rights to internal benchmarks."

We sign off on the quote as Alyssa suggested above. The logo attachment is good.

We are cleared for the Apr 20, 12:00 PM PT embargo, but please keep the Apr 14 final-approval cutoff in case we need an extra day.
